firstLines: • Lead the shipment events service in Go, handling about 40 million events a day from 300 warehouses
• Moved the service from a single database to partitioned PostgreSQL tables, cutting p95 write latency from 220
• Wrote the team's on-call runbook and alert rules; pages per week dropped from 14 to 4 after the first quarter
• Mentor two junior engineers and review about 15 pull requests a week
• Added tracing to four shipment services, so finding a failing step takes minutes instead of hours
• Built the carrier rate API in Python and FastAPI, used by the pricing team to quote about 9,000 loads a day
• Set up Terraform for the team's AWS accounts, replacing hand-made resources and shortening new
environment setup from two days to an hour
• Added contract tests between four services, catching breaking changes before deploys
• Took part in the on-call rotation and wrote six incident reviews
• A small web tool that shows Kafka consumer lag by team and topic, with about 600 stars on GitHub
• A phone app that combines forecasts and trail reports for hikers; about 2,000 monthly users
